claims.claim: An assistant decision with no supersedes, or with an unrelated target, can no longer replace a user decision at the same coordinate through validate → plan → apply.
claims.harness: 16-case matrix; real validator, planner and reducer
claims.configuration: assistant decision vs user decision; no supersedes, unrelated target, same-packet conflict, mixed source, stale quote
claims.limitation: Deterministic contract only; it says nothing about model behaviour or product quality. The stale-source rule uses message order, not semantic entailment.

claims.claim: The 96 E2E failures split into 17 produce, 13 write, 12 schema and 5 verify; no failure can be shown to be an observation failure from the recorded text.
claims.harness: offline reconstruction from reports, 25 ordered trajectories and request previews
claims.configuration: the six E2E campaigns as executed; no new call
claims.limitation: Post hoc. C is unknown in 35 memory-task cells because tool text was truncated; the 12 cells that produced a value with neither visible source are not explained.

claims.claim: An archive locator resolves to the archived message it names, distinguishes two reads of one path, refuses a missing bundle, another session and a digest mismatch, and drops an untrusted argument.
claims.harness: 11-case suite over the real bundle store and recall path
claims.configuration: archiveLocator on for the contract test; default off
claims.limitation: It proves the address is correct and bounded, not that a model uses it. A three-locator section costs ~169 tokens by chars/4.

claims.claim: All 22 task instances fail initially, pass with the reference, fail with the counterfactual, and seed above the pressure threshold.
claims.harness: the E2E checker and seed meter
claims.limitation: Offline certification; the four new templates have never met a model.

claims.claim: The L×G design is 120 cells (6 templates × 2 seeds × 2 replicates × 5 arms) with an 18-cell reserve, frozen and not executed.
claims.limitation: No authorization and no run. The requested envelope is not granted.

claims.claim: The 96-cell raw evidence is preserved in a 1,224-file, 38 MB package with a verified git bundle and zero credentials found by the scan.
claims.harness: copy + SHA256SUMS + git bundle verify + credential scan
claims.limitation: The archive is external; the repository carries only its hashes. The scan covers text files, not the compressed bundle.

claims.claim: The EF-R1 tarball installs and mounts basic/economy/quality with semantic continuity off, and contains no raw run, credential or checkout path.
claims.limitation: Construction and composition only; no provider request and no behavioural claim.

claims.claim: EF-R1 made zero provider requests and zero remote Git operations.
claims.limitation: A constraint on this round, not evidence about the product.

note: The C0 registry is unchanged. This file adds EF-R1 claims; a missing artifact is reported, never inferred.
